meta_description: VHN Decorating is a trusted painter and decorator in Winchester serving Hampshire and Southampton. Fast, efficient work with excellent results. Call Vicky today.
hero_subhead: Interior and exterior painting that transforms your home. Efficient, meticulous work from a decorator you can trust.
services_heading: Interior & Exterior Painting Services Across Winchester
services_subhead: From feature walls to full house redecorating, Vicky handles every job with care and precision.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Refresh living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, and hallways with expert finish and minimal disruption. We prepare surfaces properly and use quality paints for a lasting result.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Woodwork
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior painting for fascias, soffits, doors, and garden buildings. We work in all conditions to protect your home from the elements.

services.title: Feature Walls & Accent Colours
services.desc: Bold colour choices need a steady hand. We'll create striking feature walls that transform your space without the risk of uneven coverage or drips.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Coverings
services.desc: Pattern alignment, seam placement, and clean edges — we specialise in hanging wallpaper to professional standards on any wall type.

services.title: Preparation & Surface Repair
services.desc: Proper prep is everything. We fill holes, sand uneven surfaces, strip old paper, and prime walls so your new finish looks flawless.

services.title: Bungalow & Residential Redecorating
services.desc: Complete interior or exterior redecorating projects tailored to your home. Fast turnaround without compromising on quality or care.

about_pullquote: I do every job as though I'm decorating my own home.
about_para_1: VHN Decorating is run by Vicky Nash, an independent decorator based in Winchester with over 15 years' experience. Working across a 20-mile radius including Southampton and Hampshire, Vicky has built her reputation on thorough preparation, attention to detail, and efficient execution. Whether it's a single feature wall or a complete home redecoration, she brings the same level of care to every project.
about_para_2: Customers return to Vicky repeatedly because she listens to what you want, gives honest advice on colour and finishes, and delivers results that last. There are no shortcuts, no cutting corners—just steady, professional work that speaks for itself. You'll find her polite, reliable, and quick without rushing the job.
reviews_heading: What Winchester Homeowners Say About VHN Decorating

reviews.text: We couldn't recommend Vicky more. Extremely satisfied each time VHN have worked for us, and we look forward to the next project. Professional, efficient, and a lovely person to have in your home.

reviews.text: Vicky came to do our sitting room and hallway. She was quick, tidy, and the finish is brilliant. Exactly what we wanted. Would definitely have her back.

reviews.text: Had Vicky paint our bungalow interior from top to bottom. She worked fast but never cut corners. Fair price, no faffing about, and the results speak for themselves. Highly recommended.
